scope: Local skill audit: cognition recall and historical state-change review scope; not release acceptance

improvements.name: recall_cognition_transitions_from_related_entities
improvements.behavior: Item/place associations discover actor/fact/clock state slots. Later cognition records are included even when their optional related-entity links change; observations, propositions, plans and uncertainty remain distinct.

improvements.name: expand_history_scope_for_new_card_decisions
improvements.behavior: Real extra card changes expand the branch to declared consumers and transitive dependents, refresh required state/world evidence and fences, and invalidate prior reviews. Saved scope never silently shrinks. Legacy candidates have a publication fence and can recover after missing plans are supplied.

baseline_reproduction.history: Extra key-card change initially published target chapter alone while a correctly declared consumer remained unreviewed. A legacy saved-change plus missing-plan recovery combination was reproduced and fixed.

unit_tests.counting: Successful test cases use addSuccess; failure/error/skip counts may include subtests

test_input_stability.scope: Python source and test files under skills, scripts and tests

local_links.scope: Inline local Markdown file targets; remote URLs and heading anchors are not checked

independent_cognition_exercise.scope: Current key location and a character old location knowledge remain distinct; no next chapter prose written.

independent_knowledge_review.scope: Slot boundaries, publication/retirement, linear query growth and actual CLI dependency hashes.

limits: Executed on Intel macOS only; seven conditional skips are not passes.

Previous validation and fixed release reports remain unchanged.
